title: SOC2 evidence daily scratchpad
content:
Quick daily scratchpad for SOC2 evidence tasks, vendor follow-ups, and policy TODOs. Informal notes, working list - not yet curated for artifacts.

Today (2026-03-04) goals:
- Triage outstanding evidence items for customer encryption-at-rest audit. Check with infra SRE on KMS rotation logs (need export).
- Finish vendor review summary for DataLake Inc. (partial) - note open question on subprocessing contract clause.
- Draft policy TODOs for retention policy update (need review from legal).

Notes and decisions:
- KMS logs: Priya said she can pull key-rotation CSV but needs the exact time windows (Jan 1- Mar 1). Action: ask Priya for export by EOD.
- DataLake Inc. onboarding: we have SOC2 Type II report from 2024 but redlines needed on subprocessors and data deletion SLA. Add to vendor-review deck.
- Evidence collection: start with high-risk folders (private-deployments repo, customer keys docs). Prefer snapshot approach rather than piecemeal.

Unresolved/questions:
- Do we accept vendor's attestation without a written subprocessor addendum? (flag for legal)
- Who owns the encryption rotation runbook? I think infra SRE (Samir) but need confirmation.

Meeting notes (today sync with Priya 11:30am):
- Confirm KMS export timeframe and format (CSV preferred).
- Review current evidence matrix: missing items for control CC-7 and CC-8.
- Agree on owner list for each artifact and deadlines for collection.

Quick links to check later:
- Confluence: /display/SOC/SOC2-Evidence (evidence matrix)
- Vendor tracker sheet: shared_drives/product/security/vendor-tracker (need updated risk score)

Bottom-line next steps:
1) Message Priya for KMS CSV export + expected ETA.
2) Draft DataLake vendor issues list and email to legal for subprocessor clause.
3) Start snapshot of private-deployments artifacts (create ZIP, note checksums).
4) Update evidence matrix with owners and target dates (aim for 2026-03-11).

Notes-to-self (short):
- Keep logs of every artifact export (date, who, checksum).
- Use GH-PR-2184 as reference for prior evidence packaging approach.
- If legal needs more context, attach the vendor contract PDF and highlight clause 6.2.

Informal reminders / micro-tasks:
- [ ] Send Priya message (11:45)
- [ ] Populate vendor review template for DataLake (draft by 3pm)
- [ ] Create evidence snapshot folder and start ZIP (block off 30m)
- [ ] Add retention policy notes to Monday agenda

Rough timeline: finish most evidence pulls by next Wed (2026-03-11). If delays, escalate to manager for extra headcount.

End of scratchpad.
todos: Ask Priya for KMS rotation CSV export (Jan 1- Mar 1) - due 2026-03-04 EOD
Draft vendor review summary for DataLake Inc. - due 2026-03-04 15:00
Snapshot private-deployments artifacts and record checksums - due 2026-03-04 12:30
Update evidence matrix with owners/ETA - due 2026-03-05
Send vendor subprocessor question to legal (attach contract) - due 2026-03-05
